text:
maya (eng-docs): FYI I ran a quick link scan on runtime docs and hit multiple 404s for images and a couple of example gist links. looks like these were pointing at the old S3 bucket.
zack (runtime): which page(s)? can you paste a couple of failing URLs so i can triage?
maya (eng-docs): /runtime/kv-cache.md and /runtime/prefix-caching.md — examples and two screenshots link to https://s3.old-uploads.redwood.com/.../img123.png and a gist at https://gist.github.com/old/abcd that 404s.
eli (platform): thanks for flagging. this might be the shortlink migration fallout. we moved assets to shortlinks last quarter, some legacy S3 paths should be rewired to shortlink service.
maya (eng-docs): i can do a tiny PR if someone confirms the preferred pattern. current manual find:

```
# find broken img refs in runtime dir
rg "s3.old-uploads.redwood.com|gist.github.com/old" docs/runtime -n
```

sam-ops: prefer rehost -> shortlink route. sed to change domain then open PR is fine for cases where the asset exists in the new store. fallback is re-upload to assets bucket and swap URL.

Suggested sed (test locally first):
```
# replace old s3 host with shortlink base
sed -E "s#https://s3.old-uploads.redwood.com/#https://shortlinks.redwood.cloud/asset/#g" -i.bak docs/runtime/*.md
```

jenna (docs-owner): i can own the runtime-guide patch this week. i'll run the grep + sed, verify assets, and open a single PR with replacements + brief changelog. @maya can you add a list of exact failed links (copy/paste) so i can double-check
maya (eng-docs): pasted list below. also found an inline code block with a curl example that references the old api host — will update that to the regional host too.

maya (eng-docs): https://s3.old-uploads.redwood.com/assets/runtime/img123.png
maya (eng-docs): https://s3.old-uploads.redwood.com/assets/runtime/flow-1.svg
maya (eng-docs): https://gist.github.com/old/abcd -> 404
maya (eng-docs): inline curl: curl https://api-old.redwood.com/v1/generate -> should be api.eu.redwood.com for eu region

zack (runtime): quick note — if any of the images are sensitive, mark them and we'll use private shortlinks. otherwise public shortlinks are fine.

jenna (docs-owner): plan: 1) run rg to create file list 2) sed replace host where appropriate 3) verify each asset exists in shortlinks (or rehost) 4) open PR titled "runtime: rehome legacy assets & fix broken links" 5) request review from @maya and @zack. aiming to open by EOD Thu.

maya (eng-docs): perfect. i'll collate the rest of the 404s and add them to the PR description as verification steps.

docs-bot: link-scan scheduled: next full repo scan on 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. pinging owners after PR merge so the scanner can clear findings.

zack (runtime): CR ping @jenna @maya when PR is up, will try to review same day. if anything looks risky we can land as a canary and revert specific files. :thumbsup:

maya (eng-docs): thanks all — appreciate the quick coordination. if anyone needs me to pair on the sed/runbook tests, i can carve out 30m tomorrow afternoon.
